capability.summary: Text model for software engineering and analysis.
capability.problem_space: Text model for software engineering and analysis. Applicable tasks include code generation, debugging, multi-step analysis, tool-assisted problem solving. Accepts text input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.

env_requirements: Endpoint exposing the documented model through Chat Completions; gateway mapping unverified
Valid API key for the selected service or an explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint
Endpoint and transport support for every requested input and output modality
thinking.type must be enabled. Disabling thinking is rejected.
Provider documentation supports multiple protocols; the actual gateway mapping remains unverified.
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.

provenance.task_profile_basis: Neutral candidate task categories based on documented operations; not an empirical model ranking or fixed role assignment.
provenance.pricing_note: Supplier screenshot rates are USD per million tokens in the existing catalog convention. Unlisted rates are unknown, not zero. Cache creation and audio rates are separate from the three legacy text rates and require accounting support before use.
provenance.configuration_note: Source capability facts are preserved by the deterministic converter. Runtime and gateway readiness still require independent validation before activation.

supplier_quote.accounting_scope: Current runtime accounting supports only ordinary input, output, and cache-read tokens. Cache-creation and audio rates are recorded for later integration.

semantic_review.task_profile_basis: Task categories derived from documented operations; no empirical quality ranking or fixed framework role.
semantic_review.context_policy: Legacy configured limit is preserved separately from documented native context; neither proves the supplier limit.
